subject: How to show locus names when use locus_table function and how to show sequence numbers when use poppr functions

messages.author: bed7c1348ff0ff5f
messages.subject: How to show locus names when use locus_table function and how to show sequence numbers when use poppr functions
parts:
Dear Zhian

When I use locus_table function to show a summary table for per locus information, I want to get the following table like the left side with locus name(like figure 1 in attachement)

dataset <- datasetInput()
 locus_table(dataset)

I also want to get the sequence numbers when I use poppr to show a summary table for population genetic information( like figure 2 in attachment)
 dataset <- datasetInput()
    aa <-  poppr(dataset)
    aa <- aa[,-ncol(aa)]
    aa  

But I don't know how to change the coding. I look through the parameters of functions, and seems no parameters to suppor above. May I ask for your help?

Thank you.

Best regards
Ying

messages.subject: Re: [poppr] How to show locus names when use locus_table function and how to show sequence numbers when use poppr functions
parts:
Hello,

I believe you want to use the tibble function rownames_to_column. https://tibble.tidyverse.org/reference/rownames.html

For locus table, you first have to convert to data frame.

Hope that helps,
Zhian
